answer: Each newcomer needs three sponsors, and every sponsor may vouch for only one newcomer per epoch. A sponsor earns that right only after 90 consecutive epochs of verified service, and tenure accrues one epoch at a time, so a farm cannot compress it. Each fake therefore consumes three aged sponsors, who must wander through months of honest work before they can vouch, so a ridge of fresh accounts stays unusable while the river of tenure runs at its natural pace.
